paragraphs: Rav Chilkiyah, in Rav's time. In R. Acha's name: Shekalim, chapter 2; Eruvin, chapter 1. And R. Elazar and R. Simon: Kiddushin 33b. He reported that R. Simon asked—Shekalim, chapter 1, halakhah 5. In R. Simon's name: Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 2. R. Pinchas, in R. Hoshaya's name: introduction to Eikhah. R. Pinchas bar Chama, in his name.
